title: Synthesis of sulfanyl derivatives of 1,2,4-triazoles via an acid catalyzed intramolecular cyclization of isothiosemicarbazones: structural characterization, E/Z isomerism, mechanistic insights and in vitro cytotoxicity
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,13433-13446
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00822D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kallivalappil Snisha, Mano Chitra Karthikeyan, Nattamai Bhuvanesh, Antony Joseph Velanganni Arockiam, Ramasamy Karvembu
Sulfanyl derivatives of 1,2,4-triazoles were synthesized via a Lewis or Brønsted acid catalyzed intramolecular cyclization of isothiosemicarbazones, and their cytotoxicity was evaluated.
